is_goal_body: return state.node == self.destination and state.constraints['stop_index'] == len(self.poi_types)
expand_body:
for _, neighbor, _, data in self.G.out_edges(state.node, keys=True, data=True):
    edge_dist = edge_weight(data, 'length', self.default_speed_kph)
    if edge_dist is None or edge_dist <= 0:
        continue
    new_elapsed_distance = state.constraints['elapsed_distance'] + edge_dist
    stop_index = state.constraints['stop_index']
    leg_distance = state.constraints['leg_distance'] + edge_dist
    # If all POIs visited, just proceed to dst
    if stop_index == len(self.poi_types):
        # No more POIs to visit, just drive to dst
        new_constraints = {
            'elapsed_distance': new_elapsed_distance,
            'stop_index': stop_index,
            'leg_distance': leg_distance
        }
        new_obj = new_elapsed_distance
        successor = State(neighbor, None, new_constraints, new_obj)
        yield successor
        continue
    # Check if neighbor is the next POI in order
    is_next_poi = neighbor in self.possible_targets.get(stop_index, set())
    # Check leg distance constraint
    max_leg = self.leg_distances[stop_index] if stop_index < len(self.leg_distances) else None
    # Option 1: Stop at POI if eligible and within leg distance
    if is_next_poi and (max_leg is None or leg_distance <= max_leg):
        visit_cat = self.poi_types[stop_index]
        visit_time = self.visit_time[visit_cat] if isinstance(self.visit_time, dict) else self.visit_time
        # Reset leg_distance for next leg
        new_constraints = {
            'elapsed_distance': new_elapsed_distance,
            'stop_index': stop_index + 1,
            'leg_distance': 0.0
        }
        new_obj = new_elapsed_distance
        successor = State(neighbor, None, new_constraints, new_obj)
        yield successor
    # Option 2: Drive past (do not stop)
    # Only allow if not required to stop here
    if not is_next_poi or (max_leg is not None and leg_distance < max_leg):
        new_constraints = {
            'elapsed_distance': new_elapsed_distance,
            'stop_index': stop_index,
            'leg_distance': leg_distance
        }
        new_obj = new_elapsed_distance
        successor = State(neighbor, None, new_constraints, new_obj)
        yield successor
